name: Flex Tape
look: Two stacked infomercial stills. Top: Phil Swift, in a black polo shirt and jeans, gestures excitedly beside a large clear water tank with a gushing leak, in front of a FLEX TAPE banner. Bottom: a close-up hand presses a black strip of tape over the hole in the tank.
use: Shows a lazy quick fix covering up a problem instead of solving it. The gushing leak is labeled as the problem, Phil Swift as the person dealing with it, and the slapped-on tape as the cheap patch or cover-up.
slots: label on Phil Swift: who is fixing it
label on the leak: the problem
label on the tape in the bottom panel: the quick fix or cover-up
examples: A bug found five minutes before the demo
A strange noise coming from the car
